title: Design System: DSH AI Providers UI

title.purpose: Settings page and major panel titles.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Host menus, popovers, and floating panels.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Compact hover and pressed feedback supplied by DSH primitives.

components.name: Settings card
components.description: Flat, host-themed container for one connection, route, model, or concurrency limit.
components.css: .ds-settings-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; min-width: 0; padding: 16px; color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary); background: var(--dsw-alias-settings-card-fill); border: 0.5px solid var(--dsw-alias-settings-card-stroke); border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-xl); font-family: var(--dsw-font-family); font-size: 13px; } .ds-settings-card span { color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Settings field
components.description: Compact field for provider names, URLs, model identifiers, and numeric controls.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary); font-family: var(--dsw-font-family); font-size: 13px; } .ds-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 8px; color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary); background: var(--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1); border: 0.5px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l4); border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-md); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary); outline: none; } .ds-field input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Capability choice
components.description: A labeled native choice used for provider selection and concurrency membership.
components.css: .ds-choice { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 28px; color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary); font-family: var(--dsw-font-family); font-size: 13px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-choice:focus-within { color: var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-choice { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Explicit status
components.description: Textual status that remains understandable without colour.
components.css: .ds-status { color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary); font-family: var(--dsw-font-family); font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-status-success { color: var(--dsw-alias-state-success-primary); } .ds-status-error { color: var(--dsw-alias-state-error-primary); }

components.name: Advanced controls
components.description: Native disclosure for sampling, request, and provider-specific options.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary); font-family: var(--dsw-font-family); font-size: 13px; } .ds-disclosure summary { cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: var(--dsw-focus-ring-width) solid var(--dsw-focus-ring-color); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: var(--dsw-radius-xs); } .ds-disclosure p { color: var(--dsw-alias-label-secondary); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: Provider configuration is an Operate-mode interface embedded in DeepSeek Harness. DSH supplies the visual authority; provider identity comes from configuration structure and technical copy rather than a parallel theme.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet, compact, task-first DSH settings surfaces.
Host-owned light and dark themes through semantic aliases.
Shared controls for actions, values, credentials, and persistence.
Provider-specific controls inside a consistent capability structure.
Responsive layouts that preserve label-control relationships.

rules.name: Semantic Alias
rules.body: Feature UI uses --dsw-alias-* variables rather than literal theme colors.

rules.name: One Interface Voice
rules.body: The embedded UI uses DSH typography and density, not the documentation site's marketing language.

rules.name: One Edge
rules.body: A surface has either a neutral border or a DSH elevation shadow, never both.

rules.name: Bound Controls
rules.body: Labels and their inputs wrap as a unit; actions wrap without separating a control from its meaning.

dos: Use DSH primitives and semantic tokens before creating a local control.
Verify light, dark, keyboard, narrow layouts, long values, and bilingual labels.
Keep read-only, loading, empty, saved, and failure states explicit.
Let provider-specific information architecture carry product identity.
donts: Do not import documentation-site geometry or palette into settings.
Do not add literal UI colors or plugin-level light/dark selectors.
Do not leave native buttons unstyled where the shared Button fits.
Do not separate a compact field from its label when a row wraps.
